Priya (PM): Need a quick triage for Optimize toolkit asks. Customers pushed batching, caching, quant recs, eval-triggered alerts. Can we inventory and pick pilot scope by EOW?
Marco (Eng): Yep. Quick question: which items require runtime KV changes vs. can be implemented at control-plane/UI level? I can estimate effort once I know that.
Elena (ML): Quant recs need an eval harness and guardrails. We should define an acceptable concordance delta (suggest <=1% abs drop) and label false-positive behavior.
Maya (CS): Anchor customers care most about quant recs and prefix caching. They want clear justifications and an audit trail. One fintech also requires canary and rollbacks.
Jamie (Design): For pilot we should show recommendations as "read-only" cards with reason + confidence. No auto-apply in pilot.
Priya (PM): Proposed triage axes: impact (cost/latency saved), risk (quality regressions), effort, measurability. Highest-scoring items go in pilot. Agree/disagree?
Ravi (Research): Add "consistency" — how often recommendation yields net win across workloads. Quant wins vary by prompt distribution; capture that signal.
Marco (Eng): Draft pilot (60-90d):
- Quant recs: offline sweep + control-plane UI (read-only) for top 3 models.
- Caching: simple prefix cache (LRU) + TTL toggle + metrics (cache-hit, token-saved).
- Batching: adaptive batch-size suggestion + opt-in runtime mode (no KV migration).
- Eval alerts: one pipeline, slack/email alerts when concordance drops > threshold with grace window.
Elena (ML): Concordance proposal: alert if <=95% match on customer eval set OR >1.5% absolute drop on internal eval. Require at least 2 consecutive runs to fire.
Sam (SRE): Observability needs: per-request tags for recommendation-used, quant-profile, cache-hit; trace IDs to correlate cost change to SLOs. Pilot can't be noisy.
Marco (Eng): Minimal recommendation schema example (pilot): model, profile, expected_token_savings_pct, expected_latency_delta_ms, concordance_delta_pct, confidence, rationale, eval_dataset_id, timestamp.
Priya (PM): Draft acceptance criteria:
- Quant recs: recommendations for top models with visible metrics; 1 customer enrolled in read-only pilot.
- Caching: >=5% token-savings on pilot workload OR documented reason; TTL and metrics available.
- Batching: >=10% cost improvement on batchable workloads without p95 regression beyond SLO.
- Eval alerts: FP <=20% on pilot eval sets after grace window.
Maya (CS): I'll check customer willingness and collect eval prompts. If they can't, we'll run synthetic sims. Customer A asked for SOC2 clause before pilot.
Marco (Eng): Rough effort (T-shirt): batching M, caching S-M, quant recs M-L, eval-alerts S. Note: KV changes would increase cost and need migration plan (created ENG-9876).
Ravi (Research): For eval-alerts, include a grace rule: N consecutive runs or M affected prompts to reduce noise. Also attach sample prompts that caused regression.
Jamie (Design): Alert UI should show top failing prompts, example LLM outputs, and link to traces. For pilot show "Investigate" action.
Sam (SRE): I'll draft telemetry schema and required tags by Tue.
Elena (ML): I'll run a quick internal sweep and post numbers by Wed.
Priya (PM): Voting: react with :one: for quant-first, :two: caching-first, :three: batching-first, :four: eval-alerts-first. I'll assemble a short PRD by Fri.
Maya (CS): :one: from me.
Elena (ML): :one: and :four:.
Marco (Eng): :two:.
Sam (SRE): :three:.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled for 2026-03-25 09:00 UTC.
Priya (PM): Thanks — action items: Maya get customer commitment, Marco validate blockers, Elena/Ravi define concordance metric, Sam draft telemetry, Jamie mock UI. Reconvene Wed standup. :thumbsup:
